keys.beat: Lampetie tells Helios, who demands punishment from Zeus.
keys.text: 'Father Jove, and all you other blessed gods who live for ever, I must have vengeance on the crew of Ulysses' ship: they have had the insolence to kill my cows... if they do not square accounts with me about my cows, I will go down to Hades and shine there among the dead.'
